Nitriles (compounds containing the -C≡N functional group) can react with certain metals or metal compounds. The main risks associated with such mixtures include:

1. Toxic gas generation: Nitriles can decompose in the presence of certain metals or metal compounds to produce hydrogen cyanide (HCN), which is highly toxic.

2. Hydrolysis reactions: In the presence of water and certain metal catalysts, nitriles can undergo hydrolysis to form acids and ammonia.

3. Polymerization: Some nitriles can undergo polymerization reactions when catalyzed by certain metals.
